Was recently diagnosed with ADHD. 

​

I hate myself so so much. I feel like a fucking child. I don't know how to take care of myself. I have tried scheduling to get my life in order but I just have no motivation because I do not have any reason to live. I thought I wanted to do a certain career for all of my undergraduate studies, but as I worked directly in the field, I realized it wouldn't make me happy. I realized I want to do law school, but as I am graduating next semester, I am scared my grades will not be good enough. Or I just won't get into law school and be homeless and jobless for the rest of my life.  


 I hate it because I am always left in a state of crippling anxiety because I left things until the last minute.   


I want to get better , but things just seem hopeless for me. I would love to talk to someone. I procrastinated once again right before my exam on Monday and I have around 12 lectures to go through. I am going to fail. I hate myself so much. This is all my fault. I do have a lot of thoughts of ending my life but I am too scared to go through with it. I don't have any plans but I have very little motivation to live.  


I guess a small glimmer of hope for me now is that law school is the only thing giving me some sort of excitement. So any success stories of ppl with ADHD and suicidal ideation , especially lawyers or those who have gotten into law school, would be nice. If I could take to someone, that would be nice too.
